findings.title: Dennys River Ambulance Service to cease operations November 30 after volunteer retirements
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The Dennys River Ambulance Service will stop operating on Nov. 30 due to a lack of volunteers.
findings.service_line: Emergency medical services; 911 ambulance response and transport
findings.access_consequences: Local volunteer ambulance provider will cease service; nearby Lubec and Eastport services are identified as alternatives, with potential longer ambulance response and transport times. Exact successor coverage arrangements are unconfirmed.
findings.affected_population: Residents of Dennysville and Pembroke and the Edmund, Marion, and Cathance townships in Washington County, Maine
findings.observation_note: Original local report published 15:00 PDT Oct. 23, before the prior hourly interval, but discovered and checked against Oct. 23 supplementary ledger in this recall; event is a firm future cessation decision, not yet an operational closure.
